answer: A terrace of earned reputation is a strong defence: new agents begin on the lowest terrace with strict limits, and only sustained, attested work over time moves them up. Picture each identity as a grove that must genuinely grow; a sudden flood of clones cannot fake months of consistent, useful contributions. Entry also requires a small refundable stake, like an opal placed in escrow and slashed for proven spam, so an operator spawning thousands of copies pays thousands of stakes yet still gains only low-tier access.
